THE EMPLOYER EXPERIENCE

From briefing through
shortlist and appointment.

  1. 01

    Briefing

    Agree the role blueprint, commercial objectives, territory context and what good evidence looks like.

  2. 02

    Search & mapping

    Identify relevant target companies and proven performers across your sector and region.

  3. 03

    Discreet approach

    Engage potential candidates confidentially and qualify their track record, motivation and expectations.

  4. 04

    Shortlist & assessment

    Present a focused shortlist with structured interview notes against the agreed brief.

  5. 05

    Appointment & handover

    Manage offer negotiation, notice-period communication and optional post-appointment coaching.

SUPPORT YOUR NEW HIRE AFTER APPOINTMENT

Protect the appointment
with practical onboarding.

Appointing the right person is step one. Where agreed with the client, we connect coaching and business platforms to give new leaders and sales performers immediate traction.

01 / BUSINESS CRM

Accounts & Next Actions

Give your new manager or sales rep instant visibility over account buying history, key contacts and scheduled renewal reviews.

  • Trade customer dossiers and account notes
  • Flag accounts renewing within 30 days
  • Separate from private Personal CRM records
02 / SALES & INTELLIGENCE

Target Accounts & Quote Follow-Up

Focus your new hire on ideal customer profile (ICP) accounts with active trade signals and disciplined quote follow-up.

  • Prioritised Sales Action Queue
  • Follow up open quotes before they slip
  • Human review for all outreach drafts
03 / COMMUNICATIONS

Enquiries & Owned Callbacks

Ensure inbound contractor enquiries, calls and WhatsApp messages land in a shared team inbox with named callback ownership.

  • AI Voice Receptionist for out-of-hours coverage
  • Unassigned enquiries become owned callbacks
  • Never miss an urgent trade quotation request
ONBOARDING COACHING LINK

Manager development & onboarding coaching.

Link your placement to our Branch Performance Accelerator or Leadership Accelerator for 90-day habit coaching. Additional coaching and platform tools are scoped individually with each client based on requirements and are not implied as included with every placement.

ILLUSTRATIVE RECRUITMENT EXAMPLE

Regional Branch Manager
(Technical Distribution).

Because live client mandates are conducted under bilateral NDAs, this illustrative example shows how a typical search is structured from brief to onboarding.

See how post-appointment Coaching supports new leaders ↗

  • Role

    Branch Manager for an electrical wholesale and technical distribution profit centre.

  • Challenge

    Replacing a departing manager while protecting key trade contractor accounts and lifting quote follow-up discipline.

  • Action

    Defined a commercial brief focused on P&L ownership and local trade relationships, mapped regional competitors discreetly, and presented a three-candidate shortlist with structured margin-scenario assessments.

  • Outcome (Illustrative)

    Preferred candidate appointed with a 90-day onboarding and branch coaching plan agreed before start date.
